# Discovery-prep brief: Club Med

Prepared 2026-10-25 for a first meeting. Every line cites its sources; lines the critic couldn't source were removed. Research by an AI agent from public web pages: check before quoting.

## Snapshot

- Club Med SAS is a Paris-headquartered tourism subsidiary; its majority owner is Fosun Tourism Group, the leisure unit of Fosun International. [1][2]
- Fosun's takeover was completed in 2015. [3]
- Club Med is an all-inclusive resort operator founded in 1950, with products including all-inclusive holidays, tours, and the Club Med 2 sailing yacht. [1][6][7][10]
- Its footprint is reported at 68 resorts in 40 countries across ownership, lease and management-contract structures, but counts vary by source (about 60 to 61 in 2026 reports). [1][4][5][10][11][12]
- Employee counts vary widely by source (about 14K to 29K), so headcount is unconfirmed. [4]

## Recent news (last 12 months)

- July 2025: Henri Giscard d'Estaing said Fosun ousted him as president; Fosun disputes his account. The dispute concerned possible relisting on the Paris Stock Exchange. [9]
- April 2026: The company set a goal of 100 villages within 10 years, implying roughly 40 openings. [10][16]
- April 20, 2026: The 2025 results release was published, reporting an average daily rate of €241, up 5% at constant exchange rates. [18][19][20]
- July 4, 2026: Club Med South Africa Beach & Safari opened. [17]
- July 2026: Club Med signed a strategic cooperation memorandum with Microsoft at its Paris headquarters. [31]
- September 17, 2026: Inauguration of its first South Africa resort is listed on the corporate news page. [18][19][20]
- November 2026: Club Med Borneo in Sabah, Malaysia is scheduled to open, with a 400-key rainforest property. [18][19][20]

## What guests say (themes)

- Guests praise warm, attentive service and staff who remember them, especially for children. [21][39]
- Activities and sports are a major draw, with more than 60 activities depending on the resort. [23][35]
- Food variety and buffet quality draw repeated criticism. [22][23]
- Slow or inattentive service appears at some properties. [24][25]
- Evening entertainment is mixed, with some resorts criticized. [26]
- Value for money, extra costs, and room upkeep recur as concerns. [21][24]

## Technology hints

- Events booking runs on a Salesforce-based app built by GoMeddo, used to schedule more than 1,000 business events a year. [27]
- Property management and group tools use UrVenue's PXMS platform. [28]
- The Group Itinerary Builder launched in April 2024 at Club Med Cancún. [29]
- The WhatsApp customer assistant was built on Azure OpenAI Service and covers 50% of conversations with Brazilian customers. [32]
- Club Med has a partnership with Thales and Google to secure sensitive HR data. [33]
- Windsor.ai was appointed for marketing attribution and data integration, though that article is about seven years old. [34]

## Ten questions for the meeting

1. Which system is the system of record for resort inventory and room status, and how does it connect to PXMS?
2. How is the Salesforce-based events booking app integrated with the booking and property systems?
3. What does the WhatsApp assistant currently handle, and what is its escalation path to human staff?
4. Which guest-facing channels exist today (app, website, booking engine), given that public information on them is missing?
5. How are Gold and Platinum pre-arrival touchpoints such as Easy Arrival run today, and who owns that data?
6. What are the current loyalty tier thresholds, given that sources conflict on them?
7. How do guest feedback and review data reach resort management, and how quickly?
8. Which resort-level decisions (food, activities, entertainment) are central and which are local?
9. How will the 100-village expansion and the Borneo and South Africa openings be staffed and systematized?
10. Who owns the Travel Agent Portal and tiered agent rewards, and how are agent bookings reconciled with direct ones?

## Three use-case hypotheses (4-check test)

| Use case | Why | Felt | Would pay | Buildable in a week | First user known |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pre-arrival personalised messaging for loyalty members | Gold and Platinum members get pre-stay services that are natural points for personalised messages. [36][37][38] | Unknown | Unknown | Probably | Probably |
| Activity recommendation for guests across resorts | A broad activity catalogue plus guest interest in activities may support recommendations. [23][35] | Probably | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown |
| Guest feedback triage for food and service issues | Repeated complaints about food variety, service speed, and room upkeep could be surfaced earlier. [21][22][23][24][25] | Probably | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown |

## Outreach email

> Hello,
>
> I'm reaching out to ask for a 30-minute discovery call. I'd like to learn how Club Med's guest and operations teams currently handle bookings, pre-arrival communication, and guest feedback, and where those processes create the most friction.
>
> I've read the public material on your recent systems work, including the WhatsApp assistant and the events booking app, and I'd like to hear from your team what matters most day to day.
>
> Would a 30-minute call in the next two weeks work for you? I can adjust to your schedule.
>
> Thanks,
> Vamsi
